description: 4K Earth Views Extended Cut for Earth Day 2021  Everything that happens on the International Space Station revolves around one thing: Earth, sixteen times a day!  So for Earth Day 2021, NASA offers a gift you can’t get anywhere else with this leisurely view of our home planet, from 250 miles up, rendered in extraordinary ultra-high definition video. Hit play, relax and enjoy.  This 4K footage was recorded between 2019 and 2020.
